concern: Uncorrected v15->v22 version search over fixed held-out splits inflates every headline held-out number (0.988, 0.918 are best-of-k); no p-values, no strict never-seen test split

Shuffle causal ablation (0.525, no CI) does not rule out fine-tune-artifact / surface-style confound; needs a cross-category or within-concept shuffle control
Verbalization 'parity' rests on n=100 with CIs spanning near-chance (49% [42,62], 46% [36,55]); no equivalence test; CI also miscalibrated vs Wilson
No verbalization-zeroing ablation; text-inversion threat (AV reads passage text not activation) unaddressed and arXiv:2509.13316 uncited
Synthetic-to-real gap (mean AUROC 0.60, chinese inverts to 0.40, clean-FP 0.14-0.24) is a construct-validity failure; safety-auditing language in abstract overclaims real-world capability
No quantitative head-to-head against concurrent competitor UAV (arXiv:2605.25903) despite asserted closed-form vs trained-adapter advantage
Cross-paper '2.3x per-model NLA FVE' ratio is uncontrolled (different depth/corpus/normalization/trunk)
Karvonen et al. head-to-head (0.887 vs 0.859) mixes AUROC with accuracy at an unspecified threshold and unspecified n
Model-organism construction underspecified; fine-tuned vs prompt-induced not separated (prompt-induced would mean detecting a context token, not a weight-level latent property)
4-bit-quantized target in the LatentQA comparison is buried; mid-layer residual geometry shift confounds the 0.573 result and the Karvonen comparison
rugpt3-large FVE 0.995 outlier drives headline 0.789 held-out mean (vs 0.738 excl.); high-compressibility hypothesis stated but not tested; 0.738 buried in prose
